requirement_snapshot.name: Account Registration and Recovery
requirement_snapshot.description: The account-access page is the shared page used by unauthenticated users to register, sign in, and recover a password, with the frontend showing the appropriate form and submit button for each operation. The local product does not implement an email-verification page, email delivery, or an external verification-code service — successful registration directly stores a sign-in-capable account and marks its email as verified; successful sign-in only stores a new session and does not create a duplicate account; after submitting an email for password recovery, the page directly displays the fixed verification code `123456` and the password-reset form, and only the correct code together with a compliant new password updates the password of the same account. Registration, sign-in, and recovery pages must use visible labels to identify fields and submit actions; after failure, non-sensitive input is retained, while password and password-confirmation fields must not redisplay submitted values.
